## Melee Weapons
When ammunition runs dry or silence is required, melee weapons are a survivor's best friend. They never run out of ammo, but they require getting close - and that carries its own risks.
## Categories
[bold]One-Handed[/bold]
Description: Knives, hatchets, batons, and short blades. Quick to swing and easy to carry alongside a firearm.
[bold]Two-Handed[/bold]
Description: Spears, sledgehammers, greatswords, and long blades. Slower but hit harder.
